name: gh_pr_review_submit
description: Submit a pending pull request review. Finalizes a draft review created by gh_pr_review_create.

review_id.description: The review ID returned by gh_pr_review_create.

repo.description: Optional OWNER/REPO. Defaults to the repository of the current directory.

event.description: Review action: APPROVE, REQUEST_CHANGES, or COMMENT.

body.description: Optional summary message to include with the submitted review.
